decisive_items: necrosis of vessel walls, and focal fibrinoid necrosis
multiple discrete, round, dry ulcers, most with central eschars
response.rationale: Strongly elevated MPO with p-ANCA and necrotizing vasculitis on biopsy favor ANCA-associated vasculitis (GPA), while cutaneous vasculitis is a broader histologic description without the specific serologic marker.

rejected.why: ANA and anti-SSA are present but low-titer and nonspecific; MPO elevation and necrotizing vasculitis are not typical of lupus vasculitis.
Erythema induratum typically shows lobular panniculitis and is associated with tuberculosis; no such evidence here.
